_comment: Protected paths for the agent layer (Phase 4). A PR touching any of these fails the required `path-guard` check, gets a comment naming the path, and is labeled needs-input. Agents propose changes to these via issue, never make them. Bash pattern syntax as used by `[[ $file == $glob ]]` — `*` and `**` both span `/`. Deliberately NOT protected (the Sunday retro PR edits them): .claude/notes/**, .claude/analyst-playbook.md, exemplars/**. No root CLAUDE.md exists today; the project file is .claude/CLAUDE.md — both are listed so a future root file is covered too. No enrichment prompt-template directory exists; the docs that function as enrichment prompt templates are listed individually.
